findings.claim: The test does not independently prove that complexity is detected: it only requires a nonzero exit for a fixture that also contains a duplicated block, so duplication alone can satisfy the assertion while complexity detection is defective.
findings.evidence: Ran `rtk tgrep -n -- 'runProbeQuality' ../frozen/cmd/tsp/quality_test.go`; it printed line 29 with only `code != 1` asserted. The fixture constructs both `Sprawl` and two copies of `block` before that assertion (confirmed by reading `cmd/tsp/quality_test.go`). The attempted `rtk proxy go -C ../frozen test ./internal/bench ./internal/check ./internal/arch ./cmd/tsp` timed out after 30 seconds.

notes: The quality regression test conflates two independent reported rules, so the claimed complexity behavior can remain broken while the duplicate finding still makes the combined exit-code assertion pass. The targeted test run was unavailable because the command timed out; this verdict is based on the checked test fixture and assertion, not a claim that the suite passed.
